beforePost.title: Before You Post
beforePost.item1: Write a clear title with year, make, and model.
beforePost.item2: Upload bright, well-framed photos from multiple angles.
beforePost.item3: Set a realistic asking price based on condition and market demand.
beforePost.item4: Highlight mileage, fuel type, transmission, and key features.
beforePost.item5: Avoid unclear contact details or incomplete information.
beforePost.item6: Double-check the information before publishing your ad.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Choose manual entry or let AI prefill the form from an image.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Confirm the vehicle details, pricing, and images before publishing.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your car goes live and becomes visible to the right audience instantly.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to post a car?
faq.a1: Most sellers can create a listing in just a few minutes.
faq.q2: Can I edit my ad later?
faq.a2: Yes, you can update your listing details anytime from your dashboard.
faq.a3: Yes, AI-assisted pricing and guidance help you set a competitive price.
faq.a4: No, but clear and well-lit images perform much better.
faq.a5: Interested buyers can reach you through the contact details in your listing.

homeFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
homeFaq.a1: Upload a car image and AutoVerge compares its visual features against available listings.
homeFaq.q2: Can I switch between English and Sinhala?
homeFaq.a2: Yes, the language toggle in the navbar changes the whole interface instantly.
homeFaq.q3: Is the AI search free to use?
homeFaq.a3: The interface supports AI-powered matching without extra steps for users.
homeFaq.a4: Yes, signed-in users can save vehicles to their favorites list.
homeFaq.q5: Do I need an account to post a vehicle?
homeFaq.a5: Yes, sign in first so your listings are linked to your profile.
homeFaq.a6: The site is responsive and works well on desktop and mobile devices.
